rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for stealing goods, including from a shop; the shop context makes the meaning clear.

example.english: Don’t think you can shoplift just because it’s chaotic; the shop has CCTV.
example.traditional: 唔好以為趁亂就可以偷嘢，舖頭有閉路電視㗎。
